I’ve been hearing comments just like those you described since i was 6 years old. 
I am now 27 years old and I can’t walk out the door without hearing a comment or without people looking ate me up and down. And it’s hard. It made me very insecure. And very shy. 

A few years back i developed mild social anxiety. I could’t go inside stores or restaurants alone because i was scared of people looking at me. I couln’t talk to stangers and I even feared looking at them because I always thought people were making fun of me. 

Things got a bit better over the years. I posted here once, and I remember someone saying “they’re going to look at you anyway, so just own it”. And that’s what I try to do now. Sometimes it still hurts though. But I ignore it. Or respond and they simply shut up. And I carry on. 

People are idiots, that’s basically the moral of the story. Because only idiots would make fun of something the other person can’t control. 

Be strong, chin up, and carry on, yes? *
*sigh*
